aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:f99cdfb0-ccc.description: Open Vacancy: This role is a current, active position and we are accepting applications. Our client is a leading non-medical home care and companionship service provider with over 1,100 independently owned franchises globally. They thrive on core values like honesty and integrity, and you’ll work alongside a dedicated team making an impact. They are currently seeking to hire 2 Service Coordinators. As a Service Coordinator, you will play a vital role in coordinating client and caregiver schedules, focusing on compliance and client satisfaction. This role is perfect for someone with a strong service orientation, attention to detail, and a passion for enhancing the lives of our senior clients. Are you ready to join a high-performing team that supports and encourages you to be your best? This fast-paced position coordinates care between our clients and professional Caregivers, aiming to create extraordinary relationships. If you're energetic, level-headed, and passionate about making a real difference, we want you to join us! Schedule: Sunday to Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday
responsibilities: Answer calls professionally and knowledgeably
Match clients and Caregivers based on needs, skills, and location
Maintain schedules, fostering quality matches and strong relationships
Monitor, mediate, and log activities in our software system
Ensure accurate client and Caregiver records
Address client and Caregiver concerns as needed
Communicate openly with colleagues, Caregivers, clients, and family members
Uphold company policies, procedures, and business ethics
Perform caregiving in emergencies if on-call
qualifications: High integrityExcellent customer service skills and eagerness to learn
Strong organizational and typing skills (60 WPM preferred)
Ability to excel in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
Adaptable and able to act with urgency
Enjoys a sense of humor
Completes criminal background, MVR, drug screen, and reference checks
Passion for working with the aging population is preferred
Familiarity with Outlook, WellSky (ClearCare), Salesforce, and Microsoft Office Suite

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:06f.title: Store Floor Lead (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:06f.team: 003 - Berkeley - Sur La Table, 1806 Fourth Street, Berkeley, CA 94710
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:06f.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Store Floor Lead at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this leadership role, the StoreFloor Lead supports the General Manager (GM) or Store Manager (SM) in achieving sales and operational goals. As a key driver of in-store performance, Store Floor Lead serves as the Manager on Duty (MOD), ensuring smooth daily operations and always delivering a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Lead the sales floor and oversee daily store operations as Manager on Duty (MOD). · Provides in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. · Support onboarding, training, and development of new associates. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture. · Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely manner to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance · Support the achievement of store sales goals through effective customer engagement and team motivation. · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Operations & Compliance · Direct employees to ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels and that the selling floor is adequately stocked and merchandised in accordance with visual standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise. · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work. · Workweeks are expected to be between 20 and 25 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. · Regular and predictable attendance. Qualifications & Experience · Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment. · 1 year

jobgether-jobgether:lever:30dd9f53-8600-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Service Assistant PT based in the United States. This part-time role provides direct customer service and library support in a welcoming community environment. You will help patrons find information, discover books and resources, and navigate both physical and digital library services. The position combines reference assistance, reader advisory, circulation support, data entry, and collection maintenance. You’ll interact with a diverse range of customers, adapting quickly to different information needs and changing priorities. The role is well suited to someone who enjoys helping others, working collaboratively, and connecting people with useful resources. Strong attention to detail, discretion with patron information, and comfort using library and computer systems are essential. You will also contribute to smooth day-to-day library operations through shelving, account support, and other customer-focused duties. Reference and reader advisory: Assist patrons with information, educational, and recreational reading needs using reference services, reader advisory techniques, and basic information-retrieval skills. Information research: Help customers locate relevant information using print resources, electronic databases, online catalogs, and community information sources. Customer service: Respond professionally to multiple and changing information requests while adapting recommendations and assistance to each patron’s needs. Circulation support: Manage patron account information, apply circulation policies and procedures, and perform standard data entry using automated circulation systems. Payments and account management: Collect applicable fines and fees through cash-management systems and accurately balance transactions. Collection maintenance: Shelve library materials according to the Dewey Decimal classification system and assist with maintaining organized collections. Technology support: Use Windows-based software, word-processing and spreadsheet applications, online catalogs, databases, and other library technology. Patron privacy: Exercise appropriate discretion when handling patron records and other confidential information. Operational flexibility: Adjust to fluctuating workloads, changing software or system requirements, and assignments across the library system as needed. Additional duties: Perform other recurring or occasional library responsibilities consistent with the scope of the position. Requirements: Education: One year of college, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience: One year of customer service experience in a bookstore, library, or comparable environment, or an equivalent combination of qualifications. Information skills: Basic knowledge of information-finding strategies, print resources, online catalogs, research databases, and remote information sources. Library knowledge: Familiarity with how library materials and information sources are organized, including basic knowledge of the Dewey Decimal System and alphanumeric filing. Collection knowledge: Familiarity with library literature and collections across fiction and nonfiction subject areas, including current and established authors and titles. Circulation systems: Basic knowledge of automated circulation system functions and standard data-entry practices. Technology: Proficiency with Windows-based software and basic word-processing and spreadsheet applications, with the ability to adapt to software updates and upgrades. Numerical skills: Ability to perform basic arithmetic calculations, operate cash registers, handle money, and balance accounts accurately. Customer service: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish rapport with library users quickly and effectively. jobgether-jobgether:lever:47a77cdf-911e-.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:47a77cdf-911e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst based in India. This is an opportunity to turn complex data into insights that support high-impact decisions in education and technology. The role combines data integration, analytics, visualization, and business intelligence across multiple data sources. You’ll build reliable pipelines, maintain data quality, and develop reporting systems that stakeholders can use confidently. Your analysis will help uncover trends, measure performance, and inform improvements to products, content, and operations. You’ll work closely with both technical and business teams in a collaborative, mission-driven environment. The position offers the chance to work with modern data tools while contributing to products designed to expand access to education. This is a 12-month contract role, with the possibility of extension, and offers a flexible, remote-friendly working environment. Automate the ingestion and integration of data from multiple sources, including Google Sheets, APIs, and internal systems, into BigQuery. Design, build, maintain, and monitor scalable data pipelines and workflows while ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. Perform exploratory, descriptive, and diagnostic analyses to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and potential issues. Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using tools such as Streamlit, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar platforms. Partner with stakeholders to define meaningful business metrics and establish systems for daily, weekly, and monthly KPI tracking. Translate complex datasets and analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences. Select and maintain appropriate tools and approaches for data management, transformation, analysis, and visualization. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate business questions and identify opportunities to improve products, content, and user experiences. Contribute to data modeling, business intelligence, and end-to-end analytics workflows as required. Maintain good data and development practices, including appropriate use of version control and collaborative workflows. Requirements 4+ years of hands-on professional experience in data analytics, ideally within education, EdTech, or a similarly data-driven environment. Strong SQL skills and demonstrated ability to manipulate, analyze, and transform data using Python or R. Practical experience with advanced statistical techniques such as multiple regression and hypothesis testing. Knowledge of applied machine learning techniques, including clustering and decision-tree methods. Experience working with data warehouses and analytics infrastructure, with BigQuery experience strongly valued. Familiarity with the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data integration, modeling, analysis, visualization, and business intelligence. Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, Streamlit, or comparable platforms is an advantage. Strong analytical and business mindset, with the ability to connect data findings to practical business decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong data storytelling skills and the ability to turn complex information into concise, actionable recommendations. Comfortable working collaboratively across product, content, technology, and other functional teams. Willingness to take ownership, work hands-on, and contribute beyond narrowly defined responsibilities in a growing environment. Familiarity with Git and good practices for version control and collaborative development. Benefits Competitive salary. Meritocracy-driven and candid working culture. Remote-friendly environment with the option to work from home.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5638b262-233a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Welsh Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Canada. This is an opportunity for an experienced Welsh voice professional to contribute directly to the development of next-generation AI voice technologies. You’ll use your performance expertise to help create training data that enables AI systems to communicate with greater naturalness, accuracy, and expression. The role combines professional voice recording with linguistic evaluation, annotation, and detailed feedback on AI-generated speech. You’ll assess pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional variation to help improve Welsh voice models. Working with advanced AI tools, you’ll contribute to refining prompts, evaluation methods, and voice design guidelines. The project offers a flexible freelance environment where your linguistic and performance expertise can have a global impact. It’s particularly suited to a detail-oriented voice actor who is passionate about language, technology, and shaping more human-like AI experiences. Record scripted training material in Welsh with clear pronunciation, natural delivery, and appropriate vocal expression. Evaluate AI-generated speech for linguistic accuracy, fluency, naturalness, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and emotional expression. Identify and annotate errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated voice outputs. Provide detailed expert feedback to help improve the quality, authenticity, and usability of Welsh voice models. Assess regional and linguistic variations to help ensure AI-generated speech reflects natural Welsh communication. Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, and voice design guidelines. Apply professional voice acting expertise to produce consistent, high-quality training data. Follow recording, quality, annotation, and project guidelines accurately and consistently. Contribute insights based on professional experience in voice performance, narration, dubbing, or related fields. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in Welsh voice acting , dubbing, narration, or a closely related performance discipline. Native-level or highly proficient Welsh language ability with strong command of pronunciation, intonation, rhythm, and natural expression. Strong ability to deliver scripted content consistently while maintaining clarity, authenticity, and appropriate emotional tone. Excellent attention to detail when evaluating speech quality, linguistic accuracy, and subtle pronunciation or delivery differences. Strong written and verbal communication skills for providing clear, actionable feedback. Ability to work independently and reliably in a freelance project environment. Experience with voice recording, audio evaluation, linguistic annotation, training, or coaching is a plus. Comfortable working with AI tools and evaluating AI-generated speech. Access to a high-quality recording setup , including a reliable microphone and quiet recording environment. Secure computer and stable internet connection suitable for remote project work. Benefits Freelance contract with a flexible remote working arrangement. Opportunity to contribute to the development of advanced AI voice and language technologies. Ability to apply your professional Welsh voice expertise to a global technology project. Pay range of $6 to $65 per hour , with the exact rate determined based on experience, expertise, and geographic location. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI tools and contribute to improving voice technology. Flexible project-based environment suited to experienced independent professionals. Please note that the role is contract-based and does not include company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance or paid time off . jobgether-jobgether:lever:b525b33b-af84-.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b525b33b-af84-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Network Engineer based in the United States. This role is an opportunity to take ownership of highly available, secure, and resilient network infrastructure supporting government and commercial environments. You will operate as a senior technical individual contributor across enterprise, service-provider, colocation, and cloud networks. The position combines deep routing and switching expertise with network security, automation, observability, and incident response. You will work on complex infrastructure challenges involving BGP, IPv4/IPv6, carrier relationships, hybrid connectivity, and network modernization. You will also help strengthen operational practices through automation, documentation, monitoring, and capacity planning. Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, independence, and the ability to communicate effectively with both customers and engineering teams. Design, deploy, maintain, and optimize enterprise and service-provider network infrastructure across on-premises, colocation, and cloud environments. Configure and operate BGP, OSPF, and other dynamic routing protocols, including route policies, redistribution, filtering, and traffic engineering. Manage upstream transit, internet peering, internet exchange, and routing relationships. Plan and manage IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, dual-stack deployments, ARIN/RIR resources, IRR, and RPKI. Implement and maintain network security controls including segmentation, firewalls, ACLs, VPNs, tunneling, access controls, and DDoS mitigation. Deploy and operate network monitoring, alerting, flow analysis, and observability platforms to maintain infrastructure health and performance. Automate network configuration, validation, provisioning, and deployment using Python, Bash, Go, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies. Lead troubleshooting and incident response for complex network issues, including packet-level analysis, root-cause investigations, and remediation. Perform capacity planning, infrastructure lifecycle management, maintenance windows, and network cutovers while minimizing customer impact. Maintain accurate network diagrams, IP and asset records, configurations, runbooks, and change documentation. Support compliance and audit activities by providing configuration evidence, addressing findings, and enforcing security baselines. Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex networking issues and provide mentorship to junior engineers. Work directly with customer technical contacts to understand requirements, communicate technical issues, and deliver effective solutions. Requirements 6+ years of professional network engineering experience in production environments, with exceptional candidates potentially qualifying through demonstrated technical ownership and relevant technical work. Expert knowledge of TCP/IP and hands-on production experience with BGP and at least one IGP such as OSPF, IS-IS, or EIGRP. Strong routing and switching fundamentals, including VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation, QoS, MTU, and fragmentation. Hands-on experience with enterprise or carrier-grade platforms such as Cisco IOS/NX-OS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS, MikroTik RouterOS, or equivalent technologies. Practical experience implementing and troubleshooting firewalls, IPsec, WireGuard, SSL VPNs, tunneling, and network access controls. Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, NTP, TLS/PKI, and load-balancing technologies. Strong IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, and dual-stack networking experience. Strong Linux administration and command-line skills. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex network problems using tcpdump, Wireshark, packet captures, and flow data. Experience developing network automation and scripts using Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages. Experience with Git and configuration-as-code practices. Abili

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:978161cd-f67.description: Know where you belong! Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire. When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week. Our Global Operations team, within the Trust and Safety org, is dedicated to supporting and protecting our user base. We are looking for a Global Operations Specialist to help us handle member escalations spanning trust & safety and support policy. Our Global Operations team investigates safety issues, abuse, bugs & app functionality issues on many of Match Group’s platforms, along with enforcing Community Guidelines and Terms of Service.
responsibilities: Protect our ecosystem, prevent fraudulent activity, enforce our TOS, and help improve the user experience across multiple dating app platforms
Investigate, troubleshoot, and drive our most sensitive, complex escalations to resolution, spanning topics across Trust & Safety and member support
Investigate bug and app functionality reports and work with Engineering to help them resolve issues
Collect user feedback on new product and feature rollouts
Be comfortable dealing with high-pressure issues, gray areas, and policy/process changes
Address sensitive content issues (graphic content, hate speech, etc.)
Communicate & co-ordinate with cross-functional partners across Trust & Safety, Engineering, Comms, Marketing, Legal, outsourced partner teams and more
Contribute to or own organizational projects and consistently drive process improvements to support the team’s goals and objectives.
